subject: UK SOC 2 transfer assurance statement request and audit window clarification
messages:
From: Simon Hall <simon.hall@medifin.co.uk>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-28T09:02:00Z
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + UK-specific transfer assurance statement

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you’re well. We’re kicking off an internal review for our upcoming SOC assessment and need a few items from Redwood to complete our supplier evidence pack:  

1) Latest SOC 2 Type II report (full report or attestation letter) covering the last 12 months.
2) A written statement confirming where customer data is hosted for UK customers (control plane + compute + KMS residency).
3) If the SOC 2 report period does not align with our audit window (Oct 1, 2025 - Sept 30, 2026), can Redwood provide a short transfer-assurance/bridge statement to cover the gap?
4) Any standard language you can provide for our DPIA and data transfer controls (SCCs/contractual measures).

Also attaching our SOC2_Request_Form_v1.pdf that lists the items our procurement/audit team will expect. Can you let me know what you can share publicly and what requires an NDA?

Thanks — would appreciate a response by end of week if possible.

Simon Hall
Head of Vendor Risk
MediFin UK Ltd
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Hall <simon.hall@medifin.co.uk>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-28T13:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + UK-specific transfer assurance statement

Hi Simon —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below:  

- SOC 2 Type II: We can provide our full SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2025-12-31 under an NDA. I’m attaching the standard public attestation and the process to request the full report. Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (attestation summary).  

- Hosting & residency: For hosted customers in the UK we operate compute nodes in the eu-west-2 (London) region and can pin tenancy for Dedicated customers. Control plane metadata is in our EU control-plane region but we can provide a written statement that production data for UK-region customers is processed in London compute pools. KMS: by default keys are managed in our multi-region KMS; we can offer customer-managed keys for Private/Dedicated where key material remains in the UK.

- Bridge / transfer-assurance statement: If your audit window extends beyond our last SOC 2 period we provide a short, time-bound transfer-assurance statement that documents controls and any compensating measures for the gap. We usually need the specific audit dates and intended customer data flows to tailor it.

- DPIA/SCC language: We have template language and a short summary of transfer controls (SCC + technical controls + logging/retention). I can share a draft for you to slot into your DPIA.

Next steps I propose:  
1) Please confirm the exact audit window you need covered (dates).
2) If you require the full SOC 2 report, sign the mutual NDA here: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/medifin-evidence-DF-4829 (I’ll upload the report there once NDA is received).
3) I’ll loop in Karthik from our security team to provide the technical details on KMS residency and the draft transfer-assurance statement.

I’ve cc’d Marissa from account success so she can help with timelines if you need exec attestation.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
From: Simon Hall <simon.hall@medifin.co.uk>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T08:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + UK-specific transfer assurance statement

Evelyn —

Thanks, that helps. Confirming our audit window: Oct 1, 2025 — Sept 30, 2026. We would prefer the full SOC 2 report if possible, but the attestation with a bridge statement will work for the immediate review.

Specific questions from our audit team:  
- Can you confirm whether audit logs and backups for our customer data are stored in the UK region or replicated outside the UK?
- For the KMS option, is key material guaranteed to remain within UK jurisdiction when customer-managed keys are enabled?
- If the production environment is hosted in London, does the control plane ever route or process tokens outside the EU/UK for telemetry/diagnostics?

If you can provide short, technical bullet answers, we’ll include them in our supplier evidence pack.

Simon
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Hall <simon.hall@medifin.co.uk>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + UK-specific transfer assurance statement

Hi Simon — happy to help and providing the technical clarifications below (short bullets you can drop into your pack):

• Compute & backups: Primary compute and customer snapshot backups for UK-region customers are stored in eu-west-2 (London). We replicate cold backups to a second EU region for DR, but replication is encrypted and restricted by contract.

• Audit logs: Retained in our EU log cluster (eu-west-2); access is role-based and logged. For Dedicated/Private customers we can configure log storage to keep copies within the customer VPC.

• KMS / keys: For customer-managed keys (CMK) the key material is stored in an HSM resident in the selected region; when you choose UK residency we ensure key material does not leave the UK. For hosted keys, metadata may be global but key material remains in the region specified.

• Control plane & telemetry: Control plane metadata (routing, billing metadata) resides in our EU control plane; we do not route customer plaintext tokens outside the EU/UK for processing. Telemetry/diagnostics data is aggregated with PII redaction and sampled; by default telemetry is stored in EU. If you need non-routing guarantees we can include contractual clauses and design an architectural review for Private deployments.

• Legal / SCCs: We recommend SCCs + a documented DPIA. We can provide a short transfer-assurance statement that references SCC adoption, technical controls (encryption in transit + at rest, KMS residency, access controls), and our SOC 2 coverage. Draft attached: uk-transfer-assurance-draft.docx.

If you confirm you want the bridge statement tailored to Oct 1, 2025 — Sept 30, 2026, I can produce a signed PDF for your auditors within 3 business days once Evelyn confirms.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
